sam.ops: For ICS: generate with UTC start and include local time string on page. For Zapier->HubSpot, use dedupe key `email+webinar_id`. If webhook fails, export CSV within 3 hours as fallback.

toni.editor: Tag Asana task `Webinar Replay - edit` and assign to me. Also mark clips that need burned-in captions for social.

zoom-bot: Webinar scheduled by sam.ops -> https://zoom.us/webinar/5554443333 (ID: 555-444-3333). Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcript: enabled.

riley.mkt: Owners: riley.mkt (messaging), sam.ops (zoom/ingest), toni.editor (editing). Dry-run tomorrow 8am PT. Any blockers?
